items.summary: Each of the 14 variants ships a CMakeLists.txt building a static CudaRasterizer library that is not ported. It is dead as shipped on CUDA too: target_include_directories points PRIVATE at <variant>/third_party/glm, which holds only stbi_image_write.h, and the per-variant .gitmodules declaring that submodule registers no gitlink. Porting it (enable_language(HIP) plus a Strategy A treatment) would require first fixing the upstream include path. Nothing consumes it; every consumer builds the torch extension via setup.py.
